caption: The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing only black ink on a white background. In the upper portion, there are three large celestial objects: a crescent moon on the left, a dark circular object with an eye and extended wings in the center, and another crescent moon on the right. Each crescent moon is encircled by a ring of small stars, and a pair of flying birds appear on either side of the central object. Directly below this, a large checkerboard pattern with alternating black and white squares occupies the center. Flanking the checkerboard are two stylized trees, with a hanging object from each, and additional small vertical elements resembling columns. On the right, near the trees, there is a group of various vessels, including urns and a bowl. The bottom section contains a structure resembling a house or temple on the left, another stylized tree, and, in the center, a cucumber-shaped fruit split open to reveal seeds. To the right of this fruit, there are objects such as umbrellas, a small boat, and, further right, a larger sailing ship with a flag. Throughout the image, the composition is framed by a rectangular border decorated with alternating circular medallions containing different patterns or animal designs, twelve on each side, four on the top and bottom, and a final circular decoration at each corner. The overall drawing is a collection of various symbolic and naturalistic elements arranged within a rectangular border.
title: Shaker Visionary Image
